description: The pie chart illustrates the time cost distribution between two phases: "Reduction" and "Efficient deployment." The larger segment, colored orange, represents the "Reduction" phase, accounting for 60.9 seconds, which corresponds to 69.92% of the total time. The smaller, blue segment represents "Efficient deployment," with a time cost of 26.2 seconds, making up 30.08% of the total. The chart visually emphasizes the significant reduction in time cost achieved through efficient deployment, with the "Reduction" phase dominating the total time. The data supports the caption's claim that efficient deployment substantially lowers time cost, as the reduction phase consumes nearly 70% of the total time, while the efficient deployment phase accounts for the remaining 30%.
caption_used: Efficient deployment methods significantly reduce the time cost, with the average total time cost before efficient deployment being 92.5s (30.5s + 62s). This represents a reduction of approximately 72.5% after efficient deployment, highlighting the substantial impact of optimization strategies.
